# Image Sorter 1.1.0

This is the first release-quality cross-platform edition of Image Sorter.

## Highlights

- One cancellable catalog scan builds the folder tree, statistics, metadata, and exact resolution groups.
- The contact sheet now remains usable at 1024×768, 200% zoom, and from the keyboard.
- The export tray shows exactly what will be copied and how much space it uses.
- Export preserves relative folders and never overwrites existing files; conflicts are renamed.
- Partial export failures leave only failed files selected, making a retry safe and predictable.
- The Electron renderer is sandboxed; navigation, downloads, permissions, filesystem paths, and IPC input are restricted and validated.
- Catalog traversal is cycle-safe and bounded, and metadata and preview decoding have explicit resource budgets.
- Large contact sheets, folder trees, and dimension indexes render progressively to keep the interface responsive.
- Folder filtering preserves path case on case-sensitive macOS volumes.
- The contact-sheet design, empty/error/cancelled states, responsive drawers, focus handling, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior have been refined.
- Deprecated GraphicsMagick and Poppler binaries have been removed.

## Downloads

- Windows x64: `Image-Sorter-1.1.0-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` or `Image-Sorter-1.1.0-Windows-x64-Portable.exe`
- Intel macOS 12+: `Image-Sorter-1.1.0-macOS-x64.dmg` or `.zip`
- Apple silicon macOS 12+: `Image-Sorter-1.1.0-macOS-arm64.dmg` or `.zip`

## Trust notice

The artifacts are built from this tag by GitHub Actions and accompanied by
`SHA256SUMS.txt` plus GitHub build-provenance attestations. They are not yet
backed by Windows or Apple Developer signing certificates, so the operating
system may show a first-run warning. Download only from this release, verify the
checksum, and do not disable SmartScreen or Gatekeeper globally.

On current macOS releases, try to open Image Sorter once, then approve only
that app with **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

PowerShell verification:

```powershell
$file = ".\Image-Sorter-1.1.0-Windows-x64-Setup.exe"
$name = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($file)
$expected = (Get-Content .\SHA256SUMS.txt | Where-Object { $_.EndsWith("  $name") }).Split()[0]
$actual = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $file).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw "SHA-256 checksum mismatch" }
```

macOS verification:

```bash
file="Image-Sorter-1.1.0-macOS-arm64.dmg"
grep "  $file$" SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c -
```

Optional provenance verification:

```bash
gh attestation verify "$file" --repo VantageInc/image-sorter
```

See the full [changelog](https://github.com/VantageInc/image-sorter/blob/v1.1.0/CHANGELOG.md).
